profile.headline: Software Craftsman
profile.summary:
I have several decades of web development experience. My knowledge, experience, and willingness to learn, combined with a customer service background, will add fresh thinking and problem resolution to any team.

C#, ASP.Net, MVC, NodeJs, JavaScript, CoffeeScript, NHibernate, NoSql databases, Windows Azure, Azure PAAS, Azure ServiceBus, Azure Storage, OpenTelemetry, Kafka, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Spring, Kotlin

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Microservices · Apache Kafka · Distributed Systems · Communication

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
http://www.integrate-solutions.com/

During my time at Milliman, Inc. I worked heavily with teams building digital transformation platforms on the Microsoft Azure platform. I participated in the design and implementation of several scalable applications to facilitate the design, configuration, versioning and execution of actuarial models across a highly scalable distributed system.

I worked hand-in-hand with the development teams, the testing teams and the operations teams to ensure success as well as facilitate a culture of communication and collaboration.

Many of my other duties included training and mentoring other developers and interns to ensure their success. I trained them in both tooling and development skills to ensure high quality development and an understanding of pragmatic skills.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microservices · Microsoft Azure · Distributed Systems · Communication

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: During my time at Russell Investments I worked along developers and internal customers to create, maintain and improve systems used by in house customers to manage risk and increase performance. As a member of an agile development team (utilizing Scrum) I participated in defining and prioritizing work along side customers and stake holders to ensure the most valuable outcomes for the business. During my time I was a team leader and mentor, not only guiding teams to success but also working closely to both teach and learn from my co-workers.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Skills: C# · Microservices · Distributed Systems · Communication

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: As an independent consultant I worked on several private contracts to assist teams. I both assisted teams with general advise and system design as well as by completing a number of specialized programming projects.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst ||   (.Net Developer)
positions.description: Produced custom applications for the use of epidemiology researchers. This included, but was not limited to, a range of tools for participant tracking systems, as well as a medical record abstracting document management system.  Worked with users to improve the UI experience of a variety of applications, as well as improve data entry efficiency.  Helped maintain legacy databases and applications, creatively dealing with implementation of software improvements and fixes. Collaborated on the refactoring of large scale projects, with a focus towards testability and extensibility. Established a WIKI to create a central knowledge base for in-house documentation. Set up a continuous integration server using TeamCity. Facilitated the advancement of development tools used in the department.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · Design Patterns · Communication

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: The scope of my duties included but was not limited to: Designing and building  websites and web applications, designing and building software applications for small businesses and large corporations, mentoring junior developers, evaluating methodologies and new technologies, server maintenance and administration, customer service, and general answer-man.

positions.title: Lead Web Designer/Developer
positions.description: Handled all of the web site design and development for New Day Media including graphic design. Performed server tasks on Cobalt servers and maintained contact with customers regarding design and development issues. Created graphic designs for customers to suit their needs. Handled tech support for customers as needed. Created new development procedures to improve design time and standards, to increase productivity.

positions.title: Programmer/ Analyst II
positions.description: As a developer, I designed applications using ASP and other web languages such as HTML and JavaScript as well as VBScript. I designed ASP-powered applications that ran using Access data sources to supply company metrics or to collect data to produce such metrics. I managed Intranet Web sites and was a LiveLink coordinator for several projects.  My other duties included, but were not limited to: scanning documents and data for electronic use, creating documents using Adobe Acrobat, and creating graphics and logos for internal use using PhotoShop. Developed a web based "Issue Tracking System" for use with multiple issue logs and multiple users.
